summary: R5 PLAYER LIFECYCLE + LOADOUT map (all paths read in full from working tree 2026-08-09). THE ONE STRUCTURAL FACT: every body a player ever inhabits — first spawn, death respawn, DBNO corpse-revive respawn, spectate return, late join, reconnect — funnels through exactly ONE inventory choke point: main.scr::playerSpawnEvent -> player.scr::manageAliveSpawning -> waitthread itemhandler.scr::managePlayerInventory (itemhandler.scr:695), which does deletePreviousInvWeapons + takeall (engine FreeInventory: strips weapons AND items, papers included) and then either grants (giveWeaponLoadout -> spawnInventory/giveInventory/backfill) or early-exits on level.coop_noWeapon. The only weapon paths that do NOT go through it are the three DBNO/medkit revive re-gives and dbno_enter's downed-pistol give — all four are already gated on the same level.coop_noWeapon flag. So an unarmed-until-loud stealth machine needs to own ONE level-flag trio at map load (coop_noWeapon + coop_startUnarmed + coop_forcePapersEquip, exactly what m2l2a.scr:38-42 does today behind coop_stealthStart), keep the papers/disguise re-establishment block that sits ABOVE the coop_noWeapon early-exit (itemhandler.scr:710-742: giveDisguiseOnSpawn engine-latch + papers item + givePapersFlag + forcePapersInHand), and flip loud through the ONE existing entry coop_armOnBlown (itemhandler.scr:1394, clears all three flags then giveWeaponLoadout+activatePlayerWeapon per active player), which is already invoked from the takeAllDisguises choke point (alarm_system.scr:704, items.scr:477 uniform removal, e1l4 ship scripts) plus m2l2a's naxos-caught and blown-on-damage watchers. Engine truth: m_bIsDisguised is recomputed EVERY frame in every gametype under g_coopDisgParity 1 (player.cpp:5479-5518, includes the bug-1631 threat>0 veto), script can only set has_disguise (setter ungated, player.cpp:11384) — so the machine's per-body obligation is exactly one thing: has_disguise=true on every new body during the window, which giveDisguiseOnSpawn already delivers.
key_facts: TRANSITION MAP - what happens TODAY on each transition (weapons/disguise/papers/engine latch):

FIRST JOIN: connect -> engine spawn -> playerspawn event (events.scr:36 'level waittill playerspawn') -> main.scr::playerSpawnEvent -> manageSetup (player.scr:184: detectCoop name protocol, loadoutpick loadout_resend re-requests armory picks from client cvars, xp_identify, LMS join lock, forces spectator) -> player fires -> skipTeamAndWeaponSelect (main.scr:487: primarydmweapon rifle BEFORE join_team allies) -> engine spawns body (EquipWeapons gives engine DM rifle briefly) -> manageAliveSpawning -> managePlayerInventory: takeall strips engine rifle, then stealth-block-or-grant. Weapons: armory picks (coop_loWeapons/coop_loSlot1-4 player flags) win over map default (level.coop_weaponLoadout from coop_mod/loadout.scr per-map table); retain path re-gives coop_inventoryWeapons. Disguise: giveDisguiseOnSpawn if level.coop_enableDisguises && !is_disguised. Papers: givePapersFlag if level.coop_itemPapers set (late-join inheritance via givePapersFlagToAll at pickup, itemhandler.scr:2530).

DEATH+RESPAWN: killing hit -> engine drops active weapon+healthbox, FreeInventory -> KILLED state -> playerDeathEvent -> manageDead (player.scr:1381, 3-frame delay): if DBNO-eligible (cumulative damage tracked, not already downed) diverts to dbno_enter WITHOUT death flags (coop_isActive stays 1); else TRUE DEATH: coop_isActive=-2, coop_respawning=TRUE, callback coop_playerJustDied -> player fires -> respawn -> manageAliveSpawning respawn branch: manageAliveRespawning warps to per-frame-snapshotted coop_respawnOrigin (manage loop, player.scr:82-88), full inventory rebuild via managePlayerInventory, coop_ammoRestore overwrites default ammo with death-moment snapshot (coop_ammoSnapshotLoop 0.5Hz, itemhandler.scr:2930).

DBNO: dbno_enter (dbno.scr:156): healthonly 100, coop_key_onDown drops heavies to world, takeall, then sidearm give (armory coop_loSlot3 else weapons/dbno_pistol.tik + ammo pistol 20 + useweaponclass pistol) GATED on !level.coop_noWeapon (dbno.scr:231) - under stealth a downed player stays empty-handed by design. Exits: (a) bleedout/letgo -> dbno_die -> 15000 damage -> true-death path; (b) revive (team-hold-USE monitor, AI medic, medkit self-revive) -> dbno_ai_revive (dbno.scr:665): takeall again then re-give chain UNDER changeGameType-0: registered inv > armory picks > map default > garand/colt/frag failsafe, + coop_giveSidearmPick + coop_reissueMissionItems + useweaponclass rifle + coop_ammoRestore - the ENTIRE weapon part skipped when coop_noWeapon (dbno.scr:728-785); medkit.scr self-revive mirrors it (:376-435); (c) killed-while-down -> dbno_corpse_monitor records fall spot; a medkit within coop_dbnoCorpseRevive window -> dbno_corpse_revive -> engine respawn + coop_dbno_reviveWarp warps the new body to the fall spot (player.scr:995-1003). Papers after ANY revive: coop_key_guardian (keyitems.scr:59) observes down->up, waits 1s, re-runs itemGetAll (bug-625).

SPECTATE+RETURN: engine Player::Spectator() sets health=max and FreeInventory BEFORE script sees it (player.cpp:10322) - the 0.5Hz snapshot loop is the ONLY memory (hp/medkits/cover/ammo, coop_ammoSaved_valid). manageSpectator (player.scr:753): marks coop_specReturn=1 only if genuinely playing (snapshot-valid test), coop_isActive=-1, clears DBNO state + HUD. Return spawn: specReturn counts as respawn for ammo restore; placement via playerPlaceAtSpawn (resetSpawn cleared the warp); coop_restoreSpectateState (player.scr:1661) restores hp floor-clamped above the DBNO threshold and re-baselines the DBNO damage monitor. Disguise/papers: rebuilt from scratch by managePlayerInventory like any spawn.

DISCONNECT+RECONNECT: player entity destroyed -> ALL self.flags[] lost (picks, coop_hasPapers, coop_hasDisguise, armory skin, deaths, snapshots). manage loop count-drop fires map callback coop_playerJustLeft (player.scr:132). Reconnect = full first-join: manageSetup re-runs, loadout_resend recovers picks from CLIENT-side archived cvars, xp_identify recovers record via cl_guid. LMS: leaving locks late join after 30s (coop_lmsAllowJoin=0) and a rejoiner gets deaths preset to lmsLives (manageSetup, player.scr:267-272). Client-0 loss triggers reconnectPlayer forced-reconnect dance (player.scr:1577).

MID-MISSION JOIN: identical to first join; mission state arrives via LEVEL vars only: level.coop_itemPapers + level.papers (papers), level.coop_enableDisguises/coop_uniformOnSpawn (disguise), level.coop_playerItem1..6 (registered items -> itemGetAll every spawn, main.scr:906), level.coop_missionItems, music via setupCmds. The stealth block (itemhandler.scr:710-742) covers the late joiner: engine latch always, papers item only after first pickup (level.papers>=1).

ENGINE LATCH: m_bHasDisguise script-settable any time (SetHasDisguise player.cpp:11384, NO gametype gate - the changeGameType-0 wraps in giveDisguise/takeAllDisguises are legacy, needed pre-parity so the SP-only Think block would recompute). m_bIsDisguised is EV_GETTER-only for script and is now recomputed per-frame in EVERY gametype behind g_coopDisgParity 1 (player.cpp:5490): false unless has_disguise && !alarm && (no MAIN weapon || active is InventoryItem - papers in hand KEEP disguise) && no actor with m_Enemy==player && IsAttacking && GetCurrentThreat()>0 (bug-1631 veto). Alarm kills it globally at engine level AND takeAllDisguises clears has_disguise so post-alarm holstering never restores cover.

MOD FLAG PLUMBING: coop_isDisguised (script-side truth for aihandler::canseeUndisguisedPlayers + bug-1639 aggro deferral) is written by weaponstate.scr (statefile hook, every holster/unholster: RAISE with a real Weapon -> false, RAISE with InventoryItem/nothing or PUTAWAY -> true) + setIsDisguised + the 2Hz coop_stealthHoldDisguise watchdog (itemhandler.scr:1303, re-asserts while coop_startUnarmed==1 and hands hold no Weapon; stops forever once armOnBlown clears the flag). weaponstate ATTACK states also fire the noise pipeline (broadcastSound explosion 1024 + sentientIsHeard) for non-silenced shots while disguised.

LOUD FLIP AS BUILT: coop_armOnBlown (itemhandler.scr:1394) is the single re-arm entry: requires coop_startUnarmed==1 (idempotent), clears coop_startUnarmed/coop_noWeapon/coop_forcePapersEquip, then per player with coop_isActive==1 && isAlive: giveWeaponLoadout(default) + activatePlayerWeapon (displaces papers from hands). Wired from: takeAllDisguises tail (choke point for alarm ON at alarm_system.scr:704, uniform item removal at items.scr:477, e1l4 Ship/PreShip), m2l2a coop_naxosCaught (:494), m2l2a coop_blownOnDamage (:593, damage + attacking german within 1600u). coop_stealthArmOnHurt (itemhandler.scr:1375) is DEAD CODE - zero callers; m2l2a's map-local blown-on-damage supersedes it.

GRANT-SITE CENSUS (every path that can put a weapon in a player's hands, each already gated on level.coop_noWeapon): managePlayerInventory:745 early-exit; spawnWeaponAssert late fallback raise itemhandler.scr:1594; coop_backfillPrimaries:1629; coop_giveSidearmPick:1755; dbno_enter pistol dbno.scr:231; dbno_ai_revive chain dbno.scr:728; medkit self-revive :376; plus armOnBlown itself. NOT gated: engine EquipWeapons' brief spawn-frame DM rifle (stripped by the takeall an instant later) and engine weapon PICKUPS from the world (world drops from killed AI - the m2l2a stealth route relies on coop_stealthStripWeapons at the uniform scene as containment, m2l2a.scr:833).

UNIFORM/MODEL: giveUniformToPlayer (itemhandler.scr:856) swaps player.model to level.coop_disguiseUniform (default german_waffenss_officer) + saves coop_alliedModel/Uniform for restore; driven per-spawn by level.coop_uniformOnSpawn && coop_hasDisguise && has_disguise (managePlayerInventory:762), turned on for all by giveUniformToAll from the uniform ITEM pickup (items.scr:289-290, which also giveDisguiseToAll). takeUniformFromPlayer restores. The model is COSMETIC to the engine disguise (flags never read the model).
mechanisms: DEFINITIVE HOOK LIST for an unarmed-until-loud stealth state machine (each transition -> owning hook): (1) ARM AT MAP LOAD, main-thread gametype!=0 branch before any spawn (m2l2a.scr:38-42 pattern): set level.coop_noWeapon=true + level.coop_startUnarmed=1 + level.coop_forcePapersEquip=true. This single trio covers first spawn, death respawn, spectate return, late join, reconnect, DBNO pistol, and all three revive chains WITHOUT touching any of them - they all already consult it. (2) PER-BODY RE-ESTABLISHMENT: the block above managePlayerInventory's coop_noWeapon exit (itemhandler.scr:710-742) - giveDisguiseOnSpawn (engine has_disguise latch for the new body) + papers item + givePapersFlag (starts coop_papersAnytime presenter) + forcePapersInHand. Any new stealth state must live here or be started from here; nothing else runs for every body. (3) PER-SPAWN ITEM PATH: main.scr::itemGetAll (:906) + forcePapersInHand (:1015) under coop_forcePapersEquip - already covers respawn/spectate-return papers-in-hand; coop_key_guardian (keyitems.scr:59) covers post-revive. (4) HOLSTER/DRAW TRUTH: engine parity block (player.cpp:5479) owns is_disguised; weaponstate.scr:64/71 owns the mod mirror coop_isDisguised; coop_stealthHoldDisguise (itemhandler.scr:1303) is the watchdog while the window is open. A new machine should READ engine is_disguised (bug-1639 pattern) rather than add another writer. (5) LOUD FLIP: coop_armOnBlown (itemhandler.scr:1394) is the one mandatory funnel - every new bust detector (guard confirms, shot fired, objective forces combat) must call it and nothing else; takeAllDisguises reaches it for alarm/uniform-removal/map-script busts already. (6) DBNO: nothing to add - dbno_enter:231, dbno_ai_revive:728, medkit:376 all key off coop_noWeapon; after a mid-window revive the guardian re-gives papers. (7) DEATH: manageDead needs nothing - the flags are level-scoped so the next body inherits the window state automatically. (8) SPECTATE: manageSpectator needs nothing - engine FreeInventory already stripped, return passes through (2). (9) DISCONNECT/LATE JOIN: managePlayerInventory (2) is the join path; only papers require level.coop_itemPapers to have been set by the pickup (givePapersFlagToAll). (10) POST-LOUD SPAWNS: armOnBlown cleared the trio, so every later spawn arms through the untouched normal path - no separate hook needed.

ORDER INSIDE ONE SPAWN (manageAliveSpawning, player.scr:918-1193): manageSetup(if new) -> primarydmweapon+popmenu -> team/LMS/holdout gates -> wasRespawn determination (coop_respawning || coop_specReturn) -> ammo snapshot loop start -> placement (respawn-warp | spawnpoint) + map callback -> dbno reviveWarp -> spawn/fall protection -> managePlayerInventory (takeall + stealth block + grants) -> itemGetAll -> playerHealth -> specReturn restore (threaded +0.6s) -> ammoRestore (threaded +0.5s) -> glue -> coop_isActive=1 -> monitors (dbno_start, medkit/cover/ammobox/ads/challenges) -> ARMORY SKIN re-force + locked-skin heal + helmet_apply (MODEL WRITERS - run AFTER the uniform give) -> objectives resync -> audio safety nets.

giveWeaponLoadout internals (itemhandler.scr:1427): carry-snapshot -> resetPlayerWeapons -> waitthread spawnInventory (kit = picks+carry merge | map default | registered inv, + mission items; spawns pickup entities) -> giveInventory under changeGameType-0 (triggereffect + ammo table + picks ammo topup) -> if has_disguise: setIsDisguised true + deactivatePlayerWeapon (the armed-but-holstered e1l4 flow) else instant desired-weapon raise + spawnWeaponAssert + coop_backfillPrimaries (bare `item` under gametype-0 beats the engine one-primary pickup rule).
constraints_for_designers: takeall = engine FreeInventory and strips ITEMS as well as weapons (papers gone, uniform MODEL survives). Every takeall site is followed by a re-give that must stay papers-aware: managePlayerInventory stealth block, itemGetAll, coop_key_guardian. A new stealth machine must never add a takeall without routing the papers back through one of these (bug-1604 was exactly this).

level.coop_noWeapon is the ONE authoritative no-grant flag; all eight grant sites consult it. Do NOT invent a parallel gate or a strip-based approach - the recorded failure class (bugs 1604/1606/1607) was strip-vs-grant races; the ledger forbids re-proposing it. Arm at map load so no grant ever happens, disarm ONLY via coop_armOnBlown so every half is cleared atomically (it clears noWeapon + startUnarmed + forcePapersEquip together; clearing one without the others makes the mission unwinnable or re-arms papers).

Player self.flags[] die with the entity: disconnect/reconnect resets everything per-player. Any stealth state that must survive a reconnect or cover a late joiner MUST live in level.* vars (the trio + level.coop_itemPapers do), never in player flags alone.

coop_isActive lifecycle values are load-bearing: NIL=never set up, -3=setup running, -1=spectator, -2=dead awaiting respawn, 1=active. armOnBlown arms only coop_isActive==1 && isAlive - a DBNO player PASSES that test (alive at 100hp) and receives a full kit while down with empty hands (activatePlayerWeapon no-ops on NULL lastActiveWeapon); the revive chain then re-gives normally. Accept or explicitly skip coop_dbno_active==1 players when generalizing.

Engine is_disguised is script-READ-ONLY and recomputed per frame (g_coopDisgParity 1); has_disguise is the only script-writable latch and its setter has no gametype gate. Keep the changeGameType-0 wraps when using the existing helpers (harmless, and giveDisguise also wrangles attack-state actors), but never chase is_disguised with a writer - re-assert has_disguise + holster state and let the engine compute. The bug-1631 veto means one attacking actor with real threat blows everyone's engine disguise readout - a stealth machine must treat 'attacked' as loud promptly or the flag flaps.

Scripts must NEVER call attackplayer on (or otherwise latch) a currently-disguised player: m_bForceAttackPlayer is one-way, cleared only in the Actor ctor - that actor is permanently disguise-blind (bug-1639).

MODEL WRITERS RACE THE UNIFORM: manageAliveSpawning's armory-skin re-force + locked-skin heal + helmet_apply (player.scr:1097-1163) run AFTER managePlayerInventory's giveUniformToPlayer and will re-dress a player holding a valid unlocked coop_armorySkin in their roster skin, stomping the disguise MODEL (flags unaffected - guards still fooled, purely visual). The heal path explicitly passes disguise models through (armory_skin_isValid fails on them) but the re-force does not check coop_hasEnemyUniform. A stealth machine that applies uniforms must either run after these or gate them on coop_hasEnemyUniform.

Every spawn briefly holds the ENGINE's DM rifle (EquipWeapons) until managePlayerInventory's takeall lands 1-2 frames later - do not treat weapon-in-hand during the spawn frame as 'loud', and do not move the takeall earlier (single-frame init rule: nothing may wait before main.scr::main completes; parse killers per docs/TRAPS.md).

World pickups are un-gated: killed AI drop guns a disguised player can grab, and grabbing puts a Weapon in inventory (holster state then decides is_disguised). coop_stealthStripWeapons (m2l2a.scr:833 containment sweep) exists for this; a generalized machine needs a policy (block pickup, or accept carry-holstered like e1l4's armed-disguise flow, which giveWeaponLoadout already supports via the has_disguise branch).

DBNO under stealth is empty-handed by design (no dbno_pistol when coop_noWeapon) - bleedout odds rise sharply; coop_blownOnDamage arms everyone on real damage with a nearby attacker BEFORE most downs, but scripted/fall damage does not (nearby-attacker filter). Decide whether a down during the window should itself count as loud.

coop_papersAnytime + enableClickablePapers both key on primaryfireheld with no Weapon active (NIL and NULL both mean unarmed - bug-1603); forcePapersInHand requires level.coop_forcePapersEquip && level.coop_itemPapers. Papers presentation silently stops working if a machine clears forcePapersEquip while leaving noWeapon set.

Spectate restore floor-clamps HP above the DBNO threshold and re-baselines the cumulative-damage monitor (player.scr:1666-1686) - any new health writer on a fresh body must do the same or it reads as one huge hit and instant-downs the player.
coop_stealthArmOnHurt is dead code (no callers). Wire it or delete it when building the machine - do not leave two blown-on-damage detectors that can both fire.

LMS/holdout force-spectate gates run BEFORE inventory in manageAliveSpawning - a stealth machine must tolerate a body that spawns and is immediately re-spectated (its per-body hook may run zero times for that body).
open_questions: Death while holding papers under stealth: the MP death path drops the active 'weapon' if IsSubclassOfWeapon() && !m_bDontDropWeapons (player.cpp ~3504) and InventoryItem derives from Weapon - does a papers pickup entity spawn at the corpse? Cosmetic if so (respawn re-gives), but unverified in play; check dmdeathdrop/m_bDontDropWeapons behavior for InventoryItems.

giveDisguiseToAll's failure-retry loop (itemhandler.scr:1028-1036) re-checks engine is_disguised after the give; under per-frame parity a player who re-draws a weapon during the wait now legitimately reads undisguised and the retry recurses until holstered - pre-parity it read the frozen window value. Worth a bounded-retry guard when the armed-disguise (e1l4) flow is next touched.

armOnBlown while a player is DBNO: kit granted while down, then revive takeall + re-give - verify in play there is no double-primary or empty-hands edge (registered-inventory registration for triggereffect-given kit pickups vs the revive chain's registered-inv tier).

manageSpectator's spectate-entry branch keys on coop_isActive != -1, which is also true for value -3 (setup in progress) and -2 (dead) - the specReturn snapshot marking is guarded by coop_ammoSaved_valid so first-join is safe, but a dead->spectator transition runs the full spectator cleanup on a body already processed by manageDead; no known defect, just an aliasing to keep in mind when adding stealth state to either branch.
